title: The Longzhong Plan; Sun Quan Avenges His Father at Last
summary: At the third asking Zhuge Liang receives him, and lays out on a map the shape of the next seventy years: Cao Cao holds the north and cannot be fought head-on; Sun Quan holds the river and should be an ally, not a target; Jing and Yi provinces are weakly held by men who cannot keep them; take those two, hold the passes, wait for the north to falter, and come out in two columns.
Meanwhile Sun Quan finally kills Huang Zu, and the head that killed his father goes on his father's altar.
history: The Longzhong Plan is historical and is close to the novel's version. It also very nearly worked.

pins.note: Lays out the next seventy years on a map.
Changes sides, and brings the river with him.
Killed; his head goes on Sun Jian's altar.
